page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head at the top, with the page number at the top left. No marginal notes. Greek lead-ins sit inline at the start of paragraphs. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: Epodus 2. versuum 14.
APerit fontem orationis in Apolline cur ista dixerit:
deinde ad alterum, quod de parentibus Cyrenes
quesiuerat.
Καὶ γὰρ σε.) Expositurus prudes vates Chiron, unde com-
pulsus Apollo in haec verba prorupit, blandè orationem
praemollit, nemo te medacio inuoluere potest. itaque scio
cur haec dixeris, amore flagrans pectus erga puellam te
cogit.
Κύρης δ' ὁπόθεν[?].) Ad alterum respondet, quod de paren-
tibus quaesierat ἄνα[?] ab ἄναξ[?] vocat. est ô Rex, Laudes Aploli-
nis luculenter perstrinxit, id est, finem rerum tenes. 2.nume-
rum etiam rerum omnium, scis etiam homini impossibi-
lia, ut arenae numerus quis sit: futuros euentus ad amussim
iam ante scis.
Εἰδήσεχρή[?].) Praemollit vaticinium suum de sobole nasci-
tura ex Cyrene, quum apud Deum & de Deo id sit habitu-
rus.
Strophe 3. versuum 15.
RAptum suadet ac vaticinatur quomodo in Libyam
deportanda, urbsque ex eius nomine condenda: Græ-
ci insulares isthuc colligedi, locique illius fore dominam.
Ἐρέω.ταῦτα πωσίς[?].) Primum honesta dicendi formula con-
gressum suadet.
Καὶ μέλλεις.) Oraculum de Cyrene in Libyam transfe-
renda. Διὸς κῆπος Iouis hortus, forsan propter Ammonium
Iouem: vel quia Ægypto vicina sit, quæ Iouis τέμενος[?] dicta
fuit. Iupiter Libycus cultus fuit a multis: unde illud Festi,
qui Macedonica conscripsit.
Ζεῦ Λιβύης ἄμμων κεραυνοφόρε.
Ἐν Θεύνιν ἀρχέπολιν[?].) De urbe extruenda in Libya ex nomi-
ne Cyrenes, vide supra 4. hymno. ἀρχέπολις dicitur prima-
ria urbs, metropolis totius regni: & nunc datiuo, reddes ei,
Cyrenæ condes eam urbem.
Ἐπὶ λαὸν.) Aliud vaticinium de Græcis insularibus isthuc
congregandis: id factum est per Battum, qui ex Thera in-
sula, Callista prius dicta eos in Libyam deduxit oraculo A-
pollinis, uti supra 4. Ode vidimus..

page.notes: Greek lead-ins and Greek verse are doubtful in several places and are marked [?]: the accents and letters of "Κύρης δ' ὁπόθεν", "ἄνα ab ἄναξ", "Εἰδήσεχρή", "Ἐρέω.ταῦτα πωσίς", "τέμενος" and "Ἐν Θεύνιν ἀρχέπολιν". The catchword "Νῦν" is also uncertain. Long s is printed as f in places and has been read as s (for example "sobole", "suadet", "scis", "potest", "amussim"). The printed "Aploli-nis" is kept as printed, with its hyphen. The drop capitals A and R are joined to their words. The double full stop after "vidimus" is printed as it stands.
